verdict.rationale: Apify's docs primarily describe an Apify MCP server that lets AI agents call Apify Actors (Apify as the MCP provider), which is the reverse direction from the story. One line (apify-docs-16) mentions 'MCP connectors' linking Actors to Notion/Slack/GitHub mid-run, suggesting some ability for Apify workflows to consume external tools via MCP, but this is thin and not clearly framed as 'plugging external MCP servers into Apify for the platform to use their tools.'
